snippet.title: STOP Ambil Duit di ATM Kalo Lo Nemu Benda Ini
snippet.description:
Sebelum masukin kartu ke ATM, pegang dulu mulut kartunya. Tarik pelan, kalau goyang, ada bekas lem, atau bentuknya beda sama mesin sebelahnya, pindah mesin. 

Cek juga atas keypad sama lampunya (tempat favorit kamera kecil), dan keypadnya sendiri. Kalau ragu sama mesinnya, pakai tarik tunai tanpa kartu di m-banking lo. Nemu alat yang aneh? Jangan dicopot sendiri, foto, terus telepon nomor di balik kartu lo, bukan nomor yang ditempel di mesin. Dan yang paling penting: tiap ngetik PIN, tutup keypadnya pakai tangan satunya.

Kirim ke ortu lo yang masih ambil uang di ATM pinggir jalan.

#atm #skimming #keamananbank #tipsbank #penipuan

Maya was separated from her herd when she was just one day old and was subsequently rescued by the Kerala Forest Department.
Months later, she suffered a fall and became unable to stand due to severe bone weakness.
Despite treatment, her condition remained critical. A veterinary medical board reportedly recommended euthanasia.
However, Maya was given another chance.
On November 6, 2026, she was transported from Kerala to Vantara in Jamnagar, Gujarat, for specialised veterinary treatment and rehabilitation.
Will Maya ever be able to stand and walk again?
Her recovery remains uncertain, but her treatment journey continues.

snippet.title: DIY Diwali decor!! ✨🌃 @SohaAliKhanP
snippet.description:
For those of you who are like me and have left Diwali decor to the very last minute - no need to panic!

I like to keep it simple, pretty and practical DIY all the way
- we use a little creativity and a lot of family participation!

Flower decorations, rangoli mats (we used them last year and they are faaaaab), a little handmade rangoli thanks to @karishmakemmu and Rashmi didi and these new sensor-activated battery-operated diyas that light up with a few drops of water!

Festive without the fuss, easy for everyone to get involved in, and a safer alternative with children and doggos around. Also as you can see Oreo had other plans with the diyas, mats and flowers So
A little light, a little colour and a whole lot of Diwali spirit.

• #happydiwali #diwalidecor #diydiwalidecor #rangolimats

Thank you @chinkysainani for being my diwali fairy and coming to my rescue! And @fairylights.events for the rangoli mats!

Ever wondered how a professional-grade football goes from raw synthetic leather to a finished product ready for the pitch? Take an immersive look inside a specialized sports manufacturing facility where skilled artisans and precise machinery combine to create high-quality footballs. This video showcases the entire production cycle, starting from the die-cutting of individual tricolor hexagonal panels to the intricate, high-speed industrial stitching that holds them together.

You will witness the transformation as expert workers carefully assemble the panels, insert the bladders, and use pneumatic pressure to inflate each ball to its perfect spherical shape. The process concludes with a rigorous quality inspection before the finished equipment travels along conveyor belts, ready for shipment to players worldwide. From the rhythmic hum of the machinery to the final bounce of the completed product, this is a deep dive into the engineering and craftsmanship behind every game ball. Experience the focus and precision required to turn simple materials into the sports gear that fuels athletic passion everywhere.
